runtime.el_pulpo_a_feira_llega_como_debe: The pulpo a feira arrives just as it should: perfectly cooked, cut with scissors over wood, and dressed only with coarse salt, smoked paprika, and an oil that tastes of the coast. This dish allows no shortcuts, and it's clear none are taken here. The kitchen knows that in Galician tradition, the ingredient leads and the cook follows.
runtime.lo_mas_interesante_de_terra_gale: The most interesting thing about Terra Galega is its wine cellar. The sommelier creates thoughtful pairings: a saline Albariño for the scallops, a full-bodied Godello for the hake, and a Mencía from Ribeira Sacra that lifts the lamb without overpowering it. Few places in the city treat Galician wine with this much respect.
runtime.el_cochinillo_de_piel_crujiente_: The suckling pig, with crisp skin and tender meat, is worth the visit on its own, although the stews are the real surprise. Service is attentive without being intrusive, and the warm, well-lit dining rooms invite you to linger. Prices are high, but consistent with what's served.
runtime.la_tarta_de_santiago_humeda_y_co: The Santiago cake, moist and rich with toasted almonds, ends a meal that begins with an old-fashioned Galician broth. Terra Galega doesn't try to reinvent Galicia: it interprets it skillfully for Bogotá. It has become one of the city's Spanish dining landmarks and a must for special occasions.

celebrations.new-year.name: New Year
celebrations.new-year.message: A new year to share around the table.
celebrations.new-year.announcementMessag: A new year begins with the excitement of what lies ahead and the joy of gathering again. At Terra Galega, we celebrate those first toasts, conversations that linger, and the pleasure of sharing a good meal.
celebrations.kings.name: Three Kings Day
celebrations.kings.message: A night of stars, crowns, and good wishes.
celebrations.kings.announcementMessage: Three Kings Day invites us to hold on to the wonder of surprise and gather with those we love. With stories, good wishes, and a shared table, we celebrate the magic of this day in the warm spirit of Terra Galega.
celebrations.valentine.name: Valentine's Day
celebrations.valentine.message: Some moments are better when shared.
celebrations.valentine.announcementMessa: Some gatherings deserve time, conversation, and a table where no one has to hurry. This Valentine's Day, we celebrate the small gestures that bring people closer and turn a shared meal into a special memory.
celebrations.sant-jordi.name: Sant Jordi
celebrations.sant-jordi.message: A rose, a book, and a story to remember.
celebrations.sant-jordi.announcementMess: On Sant Jordi, roses and books remind us that there is always a new story to share. May this day be a chance to meet, talk, and enjoy together the flavors that also tell the story of Terra Galega.
celebrations.colombia.name: Colombian Independence Day
celebrations.colombia.message: We celebrate the colors and stories of Colombia.
celebrations.colombia.announcementMessag: Today we honor independence and the stories that shape Colombia. With its colors, its memory, and the joy of coming together, we celebrate from our table in Bogotá, where different traditions find a place to meet.
celebrations.halloween.name: Halloween
celebrations.halloween.message: A night of apparitions and surprises at Terra Galega.
celebrations.halloween.announcementMessa: As Halloween arrives, the night fills with mystery and stories worth telling. At Terra Galega, we join the celebration with a touch of the unexpected and an invitation to enjoy a different kind of evening together.
celebrations.christmas.name: Christmas
celebrations.christmas.message: The magic of Christmas is shared around the table.
celebrations.christmas.announcementMessa: Christmas brings us together around the people, stories, and flavors we remember throughout the year. From Terra Galega, we wish you a celebration full of warm gatherings, good moments, and time with those who make this season special.
